heading.title: Of the Powers of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Purchase by executor or administrator of deceased’s property.
article.content: If any executor or administrator purchases, either directly or indirectly, any part of the property of the deceased, the sale is voidable at the instance of any other person interested in the property sold.
article.html:
310Purchase by executor or administrator of deceased’s property.

Section 310 · Part IX · Chapter VI · page 83 of the Act

If any executor or administrator purchases, either directly or indirectly, any part of the property of the deceased, the sale is voidable at the instance of any other person interested in the property sold.
